Stage 2 · What I Offer

Find your value in the evidence.

Who are you speaking to?

Conversation opener

Stage 5 · Do the Reps

Practice builds confidence.

A good pitch becomes useful when you can deliver the idea naturally in different conversations.

Rep #1 · Read it

Read your pitch aloud once. Don't worry about memorizing it.

Rep #2 · Say it naturally

Look away from the screen and explain your pitch in your own words.

Rep #3 · Adapt it

Imagine you're talking to a recruiter instead of a friend. Change the emphasis, not who you are.

Rep #4 · Start a conversation

Finish with a question or invitation that gives the other person an easy way in.

Your next step: Use the pitch in a real conversation this week. Real reps create real confidence.
